{"reason": "v1's 20 false arbitrations (rate 0.714) are mostly low-confidence events: 6 of 8 sampled misses have confidence 0.44-0.67. Adding a (high-confidence? edi-change) gate filters those while keeping pct/exposure/frozen tests, so recall should stay >= 0.8 and the rate falls.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and
   (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
   (> inventory-exposure 500000)
   (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
   (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
